title: Effect of Closures of Small F&B Shops on Neighbourhood Vibrancy, Social Cohesion and Community Resilience
what_it_is: Effect of Closures of Small F&B Shops on Neighbourhood Vibrancy, Social Cohesion and Community Resilience

sections.label: HDB rental shop vacancy rates
sections.summary: HDB rental shop vacancy rates have stayed low and stable over five years, with churn and trade mix controls ensuring a variety of shops for residents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Vacancy rates for Housing and Development Board (HDB) rental shops have remained low and stable over the past five years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Some amount of churn is healthy, as it allows less competitive businesses to exit and new businesses to enter, which provide products and services that can better meet the needs of residents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: HDB uses trade mix controls for HDB rental shops to ensure a good variety of shops to serve residents.
